review_candidates.title: General Manager; Luxury Safari Lodge & Private Game Reserve
review_candidates.description: Job Location: Anantara Stanley & Livingstone Victoria Falls Hotel Anantara Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hotel and resort brand rooted in Thai culture, with an intrinsic sense of authentic hospitality. Inspired by the Sanskrit word meaning ‘without end’, our spirit embodies freedom, movement, and harmony. We believe every journey should leave a lasting impression — for our guests and for our people. Founded in 2001 in Thailand, we have since expanded across the world, welcoming guests in some of the world’s most captivating locales — from pristine beaches and private islands to ancient sites and vibrant metropolises. If you are driven by a passion for generosity, warmth and heartfelt hospitality, Anantara offers a career without limits. Nestled within a private game reserve just minutes from Victoria Falls, Anantara Stanley & Livingstone Boutique Hotel offers an intimate luxury safari experience where exceptional service, conservation, and authentic African hospitality come together. We are seeking an experienced, commercially astute and inspirational General Manager to lead this prestigious boutique property into its next chapter of excellence. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate luxury hospitality leader who understands the unique demands of lodge operations, enjoys being highly visible to guests and team members alike, and is committed to creating memorable experiences while delivering exceptional commercial performance. About The Role As General Manager, you will have overall responsibility for every aspect of the operation, ensuring the seamless integration of accommodation, food and beverage, guest activities, maintenance, security, conservation initiatives and team engagement. Working closely with regional leadership, you will drive operational excellence, commercial performance and guest satisfaction while positioning Anantara Stanley & Livingstone as one of Southern Africa's premier luxury boutique safari destinations. As the senior ambassador for the property, you will represent Anantara Stanley & Livingstone with owners, government authorities, tourism bodies, conservation partners, local communities and luxury travel partners, strengthening the property's reputation as a leader in luxury hospitality, responsible tourism and conservation. You will inspire a culture of personalised service, foster a highly engaged team, and ensure every guest leaves with lasting memories of an authentic African luxury experience. Key Responsibilities Provide strategic leadership across all operational departments, ensuring exceptional service and operational excellence. Lead all aspects of the lodge operation, including Rooms, Food & Beverage, Safari Activities, Engineering, Security, Finance and People & Culture. Deliver exceptional guest experiences by curating every touchpoint—from arrival to departure—including accommodation, dining, personalised service and safari experiences. Drive a culture of luxury hospitality where every interaction exceeds guest expectations. Build, inspire and develop a high-performing leadership team through coaching, mentoring and succession planning. Foster a positive workplace culture built on accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. Drive commercial performance through effective revenue management, forecasting, budgeting, cost control and profitability. Maximise occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and overall financial performance while maintaining the highest luxury standards. Develop and execute business plans aligned with the property's strategic objectives. Work closely with Sales, Revenue Management and Marketing teams to strengthen the property's positioning within the luxury travel market. Build strong relationships with luxury travel advisors, Destination Management Companies (DMCs), tour operators and strategic partners, actively promoting the property within the luxury travel sector. Represent the property by hosting key clients, VIP guests, media, familiarisation trips and key industry events. Build and maintain strong relationships with government authorities, tourism organisations, regulatory bodies and industry associations, ensuring compliance while contributing to the ongoing development and promotion of the Victoria Falls destination. Partner closely with reserve management, conservation organisations and local environmental groups to champion wildlife conservation, sustainability initiatives and responsible tourism practices that protect the unique ecosystem of the Stanley & Livingstone Private Game Reserve. Foster meaningful relationships with local communities and support initiatives that create positive social, environmental and economic impact. Represent the property within the local tourism and hospitality community, participating in destination marketing initiatives, tourism forums and strategic partnerships that enhance the property's profile and strengthen Victoria Falls as a world-class luxury destination. Ensure the property, facilities and guest areas are maintained to the highest standards through effective asset management, preventative maintenance and capital planning. Ensure compliance with company policies, brand standards and all statutory, health, safety and environmental requirements. Qualifications & Experience Significant senior leadership experience as a General Manager or Hotel Manager within a safari lodge, luxury hotel, boutique property. Previous experience managing a luxury safari lodge, boutique resort or remote hospitality operation will be highly regarded. Demonstrated success in delivering exceptional guest satisfaction alongside strong commercial and financial performance. Proven experience managing budgets, forecasting, revenue optimisation, business planning and owner expectations. Demonstrated experience building productive relationships with government agencies, tourism authorities, conservation organisations, local communities and key stakeholders. Experience working within an internationally recognised luxury hospitality brand is preferred. Strong understanding of luxury service standards and personalised guest experiences. Experience leading multicultural teams and creating highly engaged workplace cultures. Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with owners, guests, travel partners and strategic stakeholders. Experience overseeing capital expenditure projects, asset management and preventative maintenance programmes. Passion for wildlife, conservation, sustainability and responsible tourism. Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills. Comfortable living and working in a remote luxury lodge environment. Experience in Zimbabwe or elsewhere in Southern Africa would be advantageous. Knowledge of private game reserve operations and safari activities is desirable. Fluency in an additional language will be considered an advantage. What We Offer The opportunity to lead one of Southern Africa's most exclusive boutique luxury safari properties. A dynamic and supportive international hospitality environment within the Minor Hotels portfolio. A competitive remuneration package. Professional development and international career growth opportunities. The opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a globally recognised luxury hospitality brand while contributing to conservation and community initiatives in one of Africa's most iconic destinations. review_candidates.title: Foreign Exchange Manager
review_candidates.description: We're Hiring: Foreign Exchange Manager Location: United Arab Emirates (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Work Arrangement: Fully Remote About Us We are a globally focused organization operating across international markets, currencies, and financial environments. Our teams manage cross-border transactions, treasury activities, financial risk, and commercial operations while maintaining strong controls, regulatory compliance, and financial discipline. The Role We are seeking an experienced Foreign Exchange Manager to lead foreign exchange operations, currency risk management, FX trading activities, liquidity coordination, exposure analysis, and related treasury processes. The ideal candidate will manage the organization's foreign exchange requirements across multiple currencies and markets, develop effective hedging strategies, monitor currency exposures, support international transactions, and provide management with actionable insights into FX risks and market movements. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement foreign exchange strategies aligned with treasury and business objectives. Manage daily foreign exchange operations across multiple currencies and markets. Monitor foreign currency exposures arising from sales, purchases, investments, loans, payroll, and other international activities. Identify, measure, and manage transactional, translational, and economic FX risks. Develop and execute appropriate FX hedging strategies using suitable financial instruments. Monitor spot, forward, swap, option, and other approved foreign exchange transactions. Coordinate FX transactions with banks, brokers, treasury counterparties, and financial institutions. Obtain competitive FX pricing and evaluate execution quality across counterparties. Monitor exchange-rate movements, market volatility, interest-rate developments, and relevant economic indicators. Analyze currency markets and provide regular FX outlooks and risk assessments. Establish foreign exchange exposure limits, dealing authorities, and risk-management controls. Ensure FX activities comply with internal policies, delegated authorities, and applicable regulatory requirements. Maintain accurate records of FX transactions, confirmations, settlements, and supporting documentation. Coordinate FX settlements, confirmations, reconciliations, and exception management. Monitor counterparty credit exposure and ensure transactions remain within approved limits. Work closely with Treasury, Finance, Accounting, FP&A, Risk, Tax, Legal, Procurement, and Commercial teams. Support cash-flow forecasting and identify future currency requirements. Analyze forecast versus actual currency exposures and recommend corrective actions. Develop currency exposure reports, hedge reports, market updates, and management dashboards. Evaluate the effectiveness of existing FX hedging programs and recommend improvements. Support the development of treasury policies, procedures, controls, and governance frameworks. Review banking arrangements, FX pricing structures, transaction costs, and service agreements. Manage relationships with banks, FX providers, brokers, and other financial counterparties. Negotiate FX spreads, transaction fees, credit terms, and service-level arrangements where appropriate. Monitor foreign exchange gains, losses, valuation movements, and hedge performance. Coordinate month-end and year-end FX valuation and reporting activities. Support accounting treatment and documentation for foreign exchange and hedge transactions. Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and controls across FX dealing, confirmation, settlement, and reporting. Identify operational, market, liquidity, settlement, and counterparty risks associated with FX activities. Lead investigations into transaction discrepancies, settlement failures, pricing issues, and reconciliation breaks. Implement process improvements, automation, and treasury technology to improve FX efficiency and control. Maintain accurate FX data, rate sources, exposure records, and transaction databases. Support treasury system implementations, bank connectivity, APIs, and automated FX workflows. Develop contingency procedures for market disruption, counterparty failure, system outages, and settlement issues. Provide guidance to business teams on currency exposure, pricing, contract currency, and FX implications. Support international expansion and new-market initiatives by assessing currency risks and banking requirements. Prepare management reports covering FX exposure, hedging positions, market movements, financial impact, and risk. Monitor regulatory, accounting, tax, and market developments that may affect foreign exchange activities. Promote strong risk awareness, financial controls, and disciplined treasury practices across the organization. Key Performance Indicators FX exposure coverage ratio Hedging effectiveness Foreign exchange gain or loss FX transaction cost and spread Hedge execution quality Forecast versus actual currency exposure FX settlement accuracy Settlement failure rate Counterparty limit utilization Counterparty risk exposure FX transaction turnaround time Reconciliation accuracy Unresolved FX exceptions Hedge accounting accuracy Policy and control compliance Treasury reporting accuracy Market risk limit breaches FX liquidity availability Banking and counterparty performance FX cost savings Cash-flow forecast accuracy Automated FX processing rate System availability and transaction integrity Audit findings and remediation Regulatory compliance Management reporting timeliness Risk mitigation effectiveness Vendor and bank SLA performance Process efficiency and automation gains Ideal Candidate The successful candidate should have strong experience in foreign exchange, treasury, financial markets, corporate treasury, banking, risk management, or international finance , preferably within multinational corporations, financial institutions, trading environments, or organizations with significant cross-border operations. The candidate should demonstrate: Strong knowledge of foreign exchange markets, instruments, pricing, and risk management. Experience managing FX exposures across multiple currencies. Practical experience with FX hedging strategies and execution. Understanding of spot, forward, swap, option, and other FX instruments. Strong knowledge of treasury operations, cash management, and liquidity principles. Experience managing banking relationships and FX counterparties. Strong financial analysis, forecasting, and risk-assessment capabilities. Understanding of FX accounting, valuation, and hedge-accounting concepts. Strong knowledge of treasury controls, governance, and compliance requirements. Experience with treasury management systems, ERP platforms, market-data tools, or bank connectivity solutions. Excellent analytical and quantitative skills. Strong attention to detail and transaction accuracy. Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving and volatile financial markets. Strong negotiation and stakeholder-management capabilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to translate complex FX risks into clear commercial recommendations. Experience working with international and distributed teams. Strong judgment, integrity, and risk-awareness.

review_candidates.title: Field Marketer - LATAM
review_candidates.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About The Role Spanish-speaking Latin America is one of our fastest-growing markets, and we're looking for a highly motivated Field Marketer to lead planning and execution of impactful events and GTM campaigns across the region. Your work will deepen ElevenLabs' presence, drive brand awareness, and generate high-quality pipeline in partnership with our LATAM marketing and GTM teams. You'll adapt and localize successful playbooks from our global programs while identifying new, high-impact opportunities unique to the region. In This Role, You Will Develop and execute event plans aligned with business objectives across Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, and beyond Organise third-party conferences, owned branded events, and strategic dinners with key customers and prospects Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and GTM teams for seamless execution Create compelling event messaging that resonates with local audiences Manage event budgets and timelines end to end Analyze event performance and provide recommendations for future improvements Build and maintain relationships with sponsors, partners, and vendors across the region What You Bring 5+ years events experience, with at least three in tech event marketing Native or fluent Spanish speaker, English fluency required Deep knowledge of the LATAM tech ecosystem and key industry events Experience working with regional event agencies and production partners Based in Mexico or Argentina We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

review_candidates.title: Engineering Manager (무신사페이먼츠/정산)
review_candidates.description: [무신사페이먼츠 소개] ​ 무신사페이먼츠는 ​국내 ​최대 패션 ​플랫폼 무신사의 결제 경험을 ​책임지는 ​핀테크 전문 ​기업입니다. 우리는 무신사, 29CM, ​솔드아웃 등 ​주요 ​패션 플랫폼에서 ​연간 ​약 ​5조 원 규모의 ​결제를 ​안정적으로 처리하고 있습니다. ​패션 ​커머스에 ​대한 깊은 이해를 ​바탕으로, 고객과 ​입점 ​브랜드 모두에게 ​가장 적합한 ​결제 ​경험을 제공하는 것이 ​우리의 목표입니다. 무신사페이먼츠는 ​결제 기술을 통해 패션 시장의 혁신을 이끌고자 합니다. 더 나은 쇼핑 여정, 더 나은 결제 경험, 더 나은 시장을 함께 만들어갈 분을 기다립니다. 패션과 핀테크의 미래를 선도하고 싶은 분이라면, 무신사의 성장과 함께할 수 있는 이 여정에 지금 합류해 주세요. [팀 소개] 정산팀은 무신사페이먼츠 엔지니어링실 산하 신설 조직으로, 연간 5조 원 규모의 거래에 대한 정확하고 투명한 정산 시스템을 구축하고 운영하기 위한 조직입니다. 무신사 페이먼츠는 독립된 금융 인프라를 갖춰가고 있으며 정산팀은 이를 위한 핵심 시스템을 처음부터 설계하고 구축하는 역할을 담당합니다. 단순한 정산 처리를 넘어, PG사와의 대사, 파트너 정산 대금 관리, 상품권 예수금 관리 등 페이먼츠 사업의 재무적 안정성과 법적 준수를 기술로 담보하는 것이 우리의 목표입니다. 이 포지션은 정산팀의 첫 번째 리더로서, 0에서 1을 만드는 여정을 함께할 분을 찾고 있습니다. 복잡한 금융 도메인을 이해하고, 이를 안정적이고 확장 가능한 시스템으로 구현하며, 조직을 이끌어 최대의 임팩트를 만들어낼 수 있는 분을 기다립니다. [담당업무] 정산 시스템 설계 및 구축: 전자금융거래법 준수를 위한 파트너 정산 대금 외부 관리 시스템, PG 정산 대사 플랫폼, 상품권 예수금 관리 시스템 등 핵심 정산 인프라를 설계하고 구축합니다. PG 대사 플랫폼 개발: 다수 PG사로부터 받는 거래 데이터를 자동으로 수집하고, PG ↔ 페이먼츠 ↔ 은행 입금 간 3-way 대사를 통해 5조 원 규모 거래의 정합성을 0원 단위로 검증하는 시스템을 구축합니다. 조직 리딩 및 팀 빌딩: 정산팀의 첫 번째 팀장으로서 백엔드 엔지니어 1명과 함께 소수 정예 조직을 이끌고, 향후 팀 확장을 위한 채용 및 온보딩을 주도합니다. 유관부서 협업: 경영지원팀, 회계팀, 정산 기획자, 결제/선불 개발팀과 긴밀하게 협업하여 비즈니스 요구사항을 기술적 솔루션으로 전환합니다. 기술 아키텍처 설계: 대용량 정산 데이터를 안정적으로 처리할 수 있는 배치 시스템과 실시간 모니터링 체계를 설계하고, 향후 확장 가능한 아키텍처를 수립합니다. 법적 요구사항 준수: 전자금융거래법 등 금융 규제를 이해하고, 법적 의무사항을 기술적으로 구현하며, 감사 대응을 위한 시스템을 구축합니다. [지원자격] 10년 이상의 백엔드 개발 경험 및 3년 이상의 팀/조직 리딩 경험이 있으신 분 Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot 등 주요 백엔드 기술 스택에 대한 깊은 이해와 실무 경험이 있으신 분 관계형 데이터베이스 설계 및 최적화 경험이 있으신 분 대용량 데이터 처리 및 배치 시스템 설계/운영 경험이 있으신 분 금융 도메인 또는 복잡한 비즈니스 로직을 이해하고 시스템으로 구현한 경험이 있으신 분 0에서 1을 만드는 과정에 대한 열정과, 불확실성 속에서도 주도적으로 문제를 해결할 수 있는 역량을 갖추신 분 명확한 커뮤니케이션 능력과 다양한 이해관계자와 협업할 수 있는 역량을 갖추신 분 [우대사항] 핀테크, 이커머스, PG, 전자금융 업계에서 정산 시스템 개발 경험이 있으신 분 대규모 배치 처리 시스템(수백만 건 이상) 구축 및 운영 경험이 있으신 분 PG사 또는 결제대행사와의 API 연동 및 데이터 대사 경험이 있으신 분 분산 시스템 설계 및 MSA(Microservices Architecture) 환경 경험이 있으신 분 Kafka, Redis 등 메시징 및 캐싱 시스템 활용 경험이 있으신 분 AWS, GCP 등 클라우드 인프라 설계 및 운영 경험이 있으신 분 예수금 관리, 에스크로, 파트너 정산 등 금융 정산 도메인 경험이 있으신 분 Jira, Confluence 등 협업 도구를 활용한 프로젝트 관리 경험이 있으신 분 [지원 서류] 이력서(필수) / 포트폴리오(선택) (참고) 이력서/포트폴리오 작성 팁 이력서/포트폴리오에는 왜 해당 문제를 해결해야 했는지, 어떤 전략을 세웠는지, 어떤 성과가 있었는지 등에 대한 문제 정의, 문제 해결, 성과에 대한 전반적인 내용을 담아주세요. 프로젝트의 성공과 실패를 떠나, 1차 면접에서 인터뷰어와 심도있는 이야기를 나눌 수 있도록 프로젝트의 이해도가 높은 이력서로 구성해주세요. (프로젝트별 기여도 표시) [근무조건] 정규직 [전형절차] 접수 기간 : 상시지원 전형 절차 : 서류 전형 - 사전 과제 - 1차 인터뷰 - 2차 인터뷰 - 처우 협의 - 최종합격 문의사항 : [email protected] [기타사항] 본 포지션은 수시 진행으로 우수 인재 채용 시 마감될 수 있습니다. 적합한 지원자에게 채용 담당자가 개별 연락 예정이며, 내부 규정에 따라 각 전형 단계별 개별 피드백은 제공하지 않습니다. 최종 합격자는 3개월간의 수습기간이 적용되며, 해당 기간 중 급여는 100% 지급됩니다. 입사 지원 서류에 허위사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

review_candidates.title: Data Center Operation Engineer (Graduate Program)-Singapore
review_candidates.description: Alibaba Cloud is hiring students who are enthusiastic and eager to learn and grow to join the data center operation and maintenance team. As a data center O & M personnel, you will be responsible for maintaining, upgrading, and managing the infrastructure, servers, assets, and security of the data center to ensure the stable operation of the data center. Through close cooperation with experienced technical experts and managers, you will continuously improve your technical and management capabilities. As a data center O & M personnel, you will have the following responsibilities: Develop standardized operation management procedures covering Facilities, IT, Assets, and Security for Alibaba Cloud’s large-scale IDC data centers. Explore and apply advanced O&M technologies in digitalization, automation, and intelligence. Oversee execution of operation standards for incidents, issues, changes, risks, maintenance, and personnel to achieve performance targets. Drive internal and external communication and collaboration to optimize resource utilization, align with business goals, and meet customer SLA requirements. Ensure the safety, stability, and efficiency of data center operations.
